info.title: EnvPilot API
info.description: Control plane API for EnvPilot environments, projects, products, settings and webhook intake.

agentAuthToken.description: Bearer agentAuthToken returned by POST /api/v1/agents/register. The one-time bootstrap token is only valid for the initial registration exchange and must not be sent to heartbeat or resource scan endpoints.

runnerAuthToken.description: Bearer runnerAuthToken returned by POST /api/v1/runners/register. The one-time bootstrap token is only valid for the initial registration exchange and must not be sent to heartbeat endpoints.

projectConfigToken.description: Bearer projectConfigToken from runner deployment instructions. This token is bound to runner identity, one-time use, and must be sent only in the Authorization header.
